note: Hand-authored fixture. Multi-stakeholder enterprise call: four speakers, competing priorities, people talking over each other.

speakerNames.label: VP Sales
speakerNames.name: Sarah
speakerNames.quote: Understood. So Sarah, you've seen the notes output. Do you want to start?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, I think that's everyone. Sarah, Ravi, Ruth — thanks, I know four calendars took a fortnight.

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: Let's use it well, I've got a hard stop on the hour.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. So Sarah, you've seen the notes output. Do you want to start?

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: Yeah. So — it was the first one of these where I actually believed what I was reading. Every claim had the quote sat right next to it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's the design, yeah.

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: My worry isn't the product though. We've bought three of these and the reps used none of them.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: What made them stop?

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: They didn't trust it. And it lived somewhere they never went.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, so the second one's the CRM push. The first one is what the receipts are for.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: Sorry, can I come in on the recordings?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Please.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: Where does the audio actually live?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Object storage, your region, encrypted at rest. It doesn't leave the tenant.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: And the model calls? Are transcripts going out to a third party?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. The transcript goes to the model provider, under our data processing agreement.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: Then I need that in writing before this goes anywhere. That's a hard requirement, not a preference.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's fair. I'll get you the agreement and the subprocessor list this week.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: And retention. How long do you hold the audio?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It's configurable. Default's ninety days, you can set it to delete straight after processing.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: Delete after processing is what we'd want.

segments.speaker: Procurement
segments.text: Can I ask the boring question.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Go on.

segments.speaker: Procurement
segments.text: What's the number and what's the term.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Fourteen seats at list is forty two thousand a year, annual.

segments.speaker: Procurement
segments.text: We don't sign annual on a first purchase.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Procurement
segments.text: Six months, then we talk again.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can do six months if we agree a review date up front.

segments.speaker: Procurement
segments.text: That works. And I'll want two references in our industry.

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: Yeah, references matter to me too. I want someone who's been live a year, not three months.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can get you two. One of them's a similar seat count.

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: Before references though — I want the security review scheduled. That's the long pole here.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Security first, references in parallel.

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: What I don't want is this dragging into next quarter. If it slips past then, we're not doing it this year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, so let's work backwards. Security review in the next fortnight?

segments.speaker: Security
segments.text: If the agreement's with me by Friday, yes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Friday. I'll send it today.

segments.speaker: Procurement
segments.text: And I need the six month paper redrafted before I can route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I'll get redlines over Monday.

segments.speaker: VP Sales
segments.text: Good. Let's get back together in two weeks with security done. I've got to go.
